_help: AI language check settings. provider: "gemini" (free key) or "claude" (paid key); only that one is used. API keys go in .env, not here. fallback_models: tried in order ONLY if the model before answered 'busy' (5xx) or 'not found for this key' (404) - neither uses tokens; empty = one request only. See available names with: python ai_language_check.py --list-models
